name: Balamitra
notes: Loves him deeply. Believes he carries too many burdens alone.

name: Chapala
notes: Worries about his curiosity. Sees much of her younger self in him.

name: Senaka
notes: Very close. Senaka shares things with Lalita she tells nobody else.

name: Marisha
notes: Often works together during harvest seasons.

name: Ila
notes: One of the few villagers who still treats her kindly.
